data.title: Unit 2 : The Animal World
Types of Animals
data.text: Click the correct option for each of these statements.
A food chain shows us how food is transferred through energy.
In a food chain, plants are known as primary consumers.
In a food chain, animals that eat secondary consumers are known as tertiary consumers.
In a food chain, animals that eat plants are known as secondary consumers.
Animals get energy directly from the Sun.
